// Runtime fakes for b-catalog.types.ts. Every fetch waits until the scenario resolves or rejects it; abort rejects it.
export const calls = [];
export function fetchModels(region, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    calls.push({
      region, signal,
      resolve: () => { resolve(Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: `${region}-1`, label: region })])); },
      reject: (cause) => { reject(cause); },
    });
    signal.addEventListener("abort", () => { reject(new DOMException("aborted", "AbortError")); }, { once: true });
  });
}
